presentation.summary: Fetch audiobook metadata and artwork from multiple book and audiobook sources.
presentation.description_markdown: Matches audiobook items across Audnexus, AudiMeta, iTunes, Audible, Storytel, BookBeat, Audioteka, and AudiobookCovers. It combines those sources into metadata and artwork for Prairie audiobook libraries.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and add **Audiobook Metadata** to the metadata provider chain for an audiobook library. The default sources need no plugin configuration; upstream availability and rate limits still apply.

capabilities.description: Metadata provider for audiobook items. Wraps Audnexus, AudiMeta, iTunes, Audible, Storytel, BookBeat, Audioteka, and AudiobookCovers.
